new_value: Already implemented. TwoSlotFilePersistence (python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_persistence.py) hardened: O_NOFOLLOW on open (dao_persistence.py:56,:440), base-dir symlink rejection (:363), explicit 0700/0600 modes via fchmod (:372,:471,:519), unpredictable per-call temp names via tempfile.mkstemp in the target directory (:463,:513) so concurrent processes cannot collide on shared *.tmp names, fsync of file and directory (:476-480,:524), bounded reads with fstat + fixed marker read (:446-447) and _MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE enforcement (:500) plus bounded catalog sizing (:64-66). Test suite python/tests/rpl/test_dao_persistence.py: 107 passed.
